validated_results.title: Prostate cancer risk related to foods, food groups, macronutrients and micronutrients derived from the UK Dietary Cohort Consortium food diaries.
validated_results.reason: Prospective nested case-control study evaluating dietary alcohol intake and incident prostate cancer risk.

extraction.population: Middle-aged and older men from five UK Dietary Cohort Consortium studies

sample_size.excerpt: In total, 1717 men diagnosed with prostate cancer were compared with 3528 matched controls without prostate cancer ( Table 1 ).
sample_size.location: Results / Study and participant characteristics, paragraph 1; total_n derived from reported group counts 1717 + 3528 = 5245

cases.excerpt: In total, 1717 men diagnosed with prostate cancer were compared with 3528 matched controls without prostate cancer ( Table 1 ).
cases.location: Results / Study and participant characteristics, paragraph 1

design.excerpt: We collected data on entire cohorts and utilised a nested matched case-control analysis to accommodate the resources required for diary coding

timing.excerpt: Multiple-day food diaries (records) completed by men prior to diagnosis were used to estimate intakes of 37 selected nutrients

continent.excerpt: A total of 1,717 prostate cancer cases in middle-aged and older UK men were pooled from four prospective cohorts

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Seven-day food diaries (five-day in NSHD) were completed at recruitment (EPIC-Norfolk and ProtecT) or ~6 months later (EPIC-Oxford) or at second follow-up (Whitehall II) or when participants were 43 years old (NSHD).
exposure_measurement.location: Participants and methods / Measurement of food and nutrient intake, paragraph 1

parallel_r3_gate_reasons: important quantitative evidence remains missing or invalid: ci_lower, ci_upper, effect_size, p_value
